casa_siete_global_strategic_guidelines.strategic_mission_summary: Casa Siete explores love, romantic relationships, personal transformation, and astrology to foster happier, conscious human connections and help couples re-enamor.
casa_siete_global_strategic_guidelines.market_positioning: The premier Spanish-language YouTube destination for empathetic, relationship-focused astrological psychology and romantic conscious connection.
core_content_pillars: Re-Enamoring & Relationship Renewal: Navigating relationship evolution, overcoming routine, and falling in love again with the person in front of you.
Astrological Synastry & Romantic Transits: Deconstructing love dynamics through Venus, Mars, Pluto, and Moon planetary transits.
Psychological Integration & Inner Child Healing: Healing attachment styles, childhood wounds, and shadow patterns in partner selection.
Conscious Communication & Systemic Harmony: Integrating family constellation wisdom and emotional intelligence frameworks for conflict resolution.
title_and_hook_formula: Emotional Urgency + Relational Question: '¿Puede una pareja volver a enamorarse después de muchos años?'
Astrological Archetype + Practical Healing: 'Marte en Leo: Cómo superar la frustración y reconectar en pareja'
Inner Child + Romantic Attraction: 'Cómo sanar la herida de la infancia para atraer el amor verdadero'
pitfalls_to_avoid: Avoid abstract or overly academic astrological jargon without direct application to relationship love and connection.
Avoid generic event promos, administrative updates, or non-descriptive episode titles without clear emotional hooks.
Avoid fear-inducing astrology forecasts that leave viewers anxious rather than empowered with constructive relationship solutions.
growth_roadmap: Publish consistent 20-40 minute video essays combining humanistic astrology with relationship psychology.
Feature high-profile collaborative dialogues with prominent astrologers and relationship therapists (inspired by Silvia Neira & Juan Carlos Gómez).
Design warm, high-contrast thumbnails featuring expressive imagery and clear, high-empathy title typography.
